# Candle workflow and branch hygiene, 2026-10-30

The current Extended campaign [41036699911](https://github.com/haricot/candle/actions/runs/41036699911) passed hosted compilation, CPU execution, physical Pascal SM61, real Nemotron CPU/CUDA parity for fr-FR and auto, and promotion of `extended` to `e0dbd926ae211ee19cf1ac0f6ae4b0cbabc00646`.

Nine superseded one-shot integration/bootstrap workflow files were removed from `orch/legacy-cuda-v1`. They had already been retired from `orch/extended-v1`. The current Legacy workflow and all of its scripts, inputs, candidates and queued jobs are unchanged.

The checked request in `cleanup-sm61-20261030.json` targets exactly 109 old preparation branches from nine completed campaigns. Before deletion, each commit is preserved by a distinct annotated tag under `archive/candle-pruned-20261030/<original-branch>`. Deletion is one atomic push with an exact SHA lease for each branch. A moved ref, an archive collision or an open PR rejects the operation. Preview and apply requests must have the same scope fingerprint.

All 112 other non-default heads are protected by the request, including every immutable integration candidate, source/standalone branch, orchestration branch and physical validation archive. The latest successful Extended preparation refs and the still-queued Legacy preparation refs are retained. No GitHub run, log, artifact, local image or model file is deleted.

The ten retired workflow paths match the historical inventory documented on `orch/extended-v1`. The cleanup disables only those registered workflow definitions, after checking that none is active. Current Legacy, Extended, CUDA image reuse, isolated ASD and upstream CI workflows remain enabled.

Mistral Legacy `40970151424` and Extended `40969865016` are unchanged, with hosted tests and digest-addressed CUDA images ready for local archive execution. Their current immutable orchestrators cannot supply full LFM3 Text/VL/GGUF model proofs: `gpu.sh` records `full_models_executed=false`, while promotion requires those model results. Qualification pushes do not publish. The prior successful physical campaign `40868356972` also reports false and has no `model_results`; its convolution tests cannot substitute for full models.
